frequency_question: What proportion of major labor union disputes complete all mandatory procedural steps and initiate an indefinite strike within a 54-day timeframe?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide federation strike notices and conciliation processes under standard labor dispute resolution acts; excludes spontaneous wildcat strikes without statutory notice periods.
coverage_note: 5 major federation-level dispute cycles evaluated; representative of statutory dispute timeframes.
known_gaps: Excludes minor regional or single-bank actions lacking national union coordination.
skeleton: Not applicable; enumerated specific cases directly.
multiplier: 5 cases evaluated, 3 hit the 54-day window threshold from formal notice to execution, 2 missed due to conciliation extensions exceeding the window.
validity_reason: Statutory conciliation timeframes and union notice requirements remain stable under current labor legislation frameworks.
